articles.title: Ondo Finance hires former Blockchain.com CFO Adam Schlisman
articles.snippet: The tokenized-assets firm appointed ex-Blockchain.com and Monashee executive as finance chief as it expands its onchain capital markets business.

articles.title: Live updates: An AI credit bubble could set up bitcoin’s path to $1 million, says Arthur Hayes
articles.snippet: Maelstrom co-founder Arthur Hayes says overleveraged AI data-center spending will eventually crack, forcing government bailouts and money printing that become the next major bitcoin catalyst.

articles.title: S&P gives BlackRock tokenized reserve fund top stability rating
articles.snippet: The rating recognizes the fund’s ability to maintain a stable net asset value, while S&P separately reaffirmed USDT among the lowest-rated stablecoins under its existing assessment framework.

articles.title: BlackRock brings tokenized money market funds to Europe via JPMorgan
articles.snippet: JPMorgan’s Kinexys platform will tokenize select BlackRock money market fund shares denominated in pounds, euros and US dollars.

articles.title: Bybit’s EU payments arm secures Austrian e-money license
articles.snippet: Bybit’s Austrian payments subsidiary gained regulatory approval to develop card, merchant, open-banking and person-to-person payment services.
